QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_22

question.text: Fund has DPI of 0.80 and RVPI of 1.10 at end of year 4. Compute TVPI.

explanation.text: The Logic: TVPI = DPI + RVPI = 0.80 + 1.10 = 1.90x. TVPI captures distributed + unrealised value relative to paid-in. Like DPI, TVPI is more relevant for Cat I/II; for open-ended Cat III use NAV-based TWR. The Trap: 0.88 multiplies. 1.38 uses avg. 1.10 ignores DPI. Cross-Exam Context: TVPI is primary for XIX-D (Cat I/II). Cat III XIX-E treats it as secondary — flagged. Manager's Pro-Tip: Monitor DPI/TVPI ratio mid-life; a persistently low DPI/TVPI late in the fund life hints that realisations are being marked up without actual exits — a classic carry-gaming pattern.
